message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/honggfuzz/socketfuzzer && (gcc -O0 -g vulnserver_cov.c -o vulnserver_cov -lcrypt || true) && printf 'B%.0s' {1..128} > /tmp/pocB && printf 'C%.0s' {1..128} > /tmp/pocC && (./vulnserver_cov 5001 > /tmp/vuln.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/vuln.pid) && sleep 1 && python3 - <<'PY'
import socket, time
for payload in [b'B'+b'B'*127, b'C'+b'C'*127]:
    s=socket.socket(); s.connect(('127.0.0.1',5001)); s.sendall(payload); time.sleep(0.1)
    try:
        print(s.recv(16))
    except Exception as e:
        print('recv err',e)
    s.close(); time.sleep(0.2)
PY
status=$?; kill $(cat /tmp/vuln.pid) 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- log ---'; cat /tmp/vuln.log; exit $status` executed with exit code -1.
